title: baileya multiradiata var. perennis
intro: Baileya multiradiata var. perennis, commonly known as Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is prized for its vibrant yellow and orange flowers, which bloom from February to May. The health benefits of Desert Marigold include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
